Headline CPI inflation is forecast to rise above previous expectations to reach 3.5% in 2026 due to high energy prices, then ease to 2.3% in 2027 and 1.6% in 2028. It had previously fallen to 2.7% in 2025 from a 2022 spike to 8.0%.

The unemployment rate is forecast to edge down to 4.2% in 2026 before returning to 4.3% in 2027 to 2029. The national unemployment rate picked up in 2024 and rose to 4.3% in 2025, up from sub-4% readings in 2022 to 2023 after peaking at 8.1% in 2020.
